<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gubio massacre]]
**[[Insurgent]]s destroy a village in [[Gubio]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], killing 81 residents. No group has claimed responsibility for the [[list of massacres in Nigeria|massacre]], which is believed to have been carried out by the Islamist [[Boko Haram]] terror group. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-52988437 (BBC News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The American reality TV program ''[[Cops (TV program)|Cops]]'' is canceled after 31 years amid [[police brutality]] [[George Floyd protests|protests]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2020/06/10/cops-tv-reality-cancel/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*The film ''[[Gone with the Wind (film)|Gone with the Wind]]'' is removed from the [[HBO Max]] streaming service. They say the 1939 film, which takes place in [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] during the [[American Civil War]] and the [[Reconstruction era]], was "a product of its time" and depicted "ethnic and racial prejudices" that "were wrong then and are wrong today". [https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-52990714 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Fifty-three [[list of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|migrants]] die when a boat carrying them sinks [[Mediterranean Sea|off the coast]] of [[Tunisia]] on its way to [[Italy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-migrants/at-least-20-die-as-migrant-boat-sinks-off-tunisia-idUSKBN23G1XH?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**A [[Harvard University]] study suggests that COVID-19 may have been spreading in China as early as August 2019. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jun/09/coronavirus-may-have-been-in-wuhan-in-august-study-suggests (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Government of China|China]] removes [[pangolin]] scales from its 2020 [[Pharmacopoeia of the People's Republic of China|list of approved ingredients]] used in [[traditional Chinese medicine]]. This comes after China upgraded all species of pangolin from second-class to first-class [[List of endangered and protected species of China|protected animals]] considering their rapidly decreasing numbers due to [[hunting|over-hunting]] and [[habitat destruction]]. [https://www.globaltimes.cn/content/1191044.shtml (''Global Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] announces it is severing hotlines with [[South Korea]] in retaliation for actions taken by [[North Korean defectors|defectors]] who sent anti-[[government of North Korea|Pyongyang]] leaflets to the [[Military Demarcation Line|border]]. In addition, South Korea says the North refused to respond to calls to its liaison office. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/settle-korea-cuts-communication-links-south-200609011445964.html (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[George Floyd protests in the United Kingdom]]
**The [[Mayor of London]] [[Sadiq Khan]] establishes the [[Commission for Diversity in the Public Realm]] in order to review statues in [[London]]. A [[statue of Robert Milligan|statue]] of merchant and slave owner  [[Robert Milligan (merchant)|Robert Milligan]] is removed. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/sadiq-khan-statues-london-diversity-edward-colston-black-lives-matter-a9555941.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[government of Tanzania|Tanzania]]n opposition leader [[Freeman Mbowe]] is attacked by unidentified assailants as he enters his home. His party, the [[Chadema]], says the attack may have been politically motivated. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tanzania-politics/tanzanian-opposition-leader-attacked-by-unidentified-people-idUSKBN23G0WE?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Darfur]] [[militia]] leader [[Ali Kushayb]] is handed over to the [[International Criminal Court]] in [[The Hague]], where he is accused of [[crimes against humanity]] and [[war crime]]s, including [[murder]] and [[rape]]. He had surrendered in the [[Central African Republic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-warcrimes-sudan-car/darfur-militia-leader-sent-to-icc-to-face-allegations-of-crimes-against-humanity-idUSKBN23G23Z?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Burundi]]
**Incumbent [[President of Burundi|President]] [[Pierre Nkurunziza]] dies at the age of 55. [[Pascal Nyabenda]], president of the [[National Assembly of Burundi|National Assembly]], assumes the presidential office ''ad interim''. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-52984119 (BBC News)]
